issue_request: FHIR-11244 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Clinical Genomics request from the DSTU2 cycle to change observation-geneticsAlleleName from string to CodeableConcept and identify an EBI allele-name coding system.
initial_application: Core commit fd5399f0f82bd204d1f110212391a298e99a5c53 applied the request by changing the AlleleName row in source/observation/observation-genetics-profile-spreadsheet.xml from string to CodeableConcept. The generated R3 history artifact then represented observation-geneticsAlleleName as valueCodeableConcept with an EBI-AlleleName preferred binding.
additional_context: The old Observation clinical-genomics profiles, extensions, and examples were removed from active core source in 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435 as outdated artifacts. Current core source has no active observation-geneticsAlleleName or observation-geneticsAllele definition; source/fhir.ini only retains geneticanalysis under [removed-resources]. The surviving retired/deprecated extension is in the FHIR Extension Pack as input/definitions/Observation/StructureDefinition-observation-geneticsAllele.json, whose Name slice is typed CodeableConcept and is marked as replaced by the Genomics Reporting Guide.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The current core checkout/current core build does not own a source file that should be edited for this issue.
